action_items: Minor docs nit (not a bug): the review request references data-testid='chat-send-btn' but the actual testid in /app/frontend/src/components/ChatPanel.jsx:2255 is 'chat-send'. Send button itself is visible & functional in Maxx mode (confirmed via screenshot). Consider updating either the testid or the spec for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: MessageBubble.jsx line 207-235: ActionBtn applies tint via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave inline handlers that mutate currentTarget.style directly. This is fine for current use but bypasses React state — if a future refactor wraps these in framer-motion or memoizes, the inline mutations could be overwritten. A :hover CSS pseudo-class on the styled border-color would be more idiomatic.

Dashboard.jsx line 269-287: collapsing the topbar uses height:auto → 0 transition. Animating from 'auto' is not natively supported by CSS — the height collapse will appear instant (skip the 200ms transition). Acceptable for the founder's stated goal (no residual strip) but if smooth collapse is desired, use max-height transition or measure scrollHeight first.

ChatPanel.jsx line 1991 + index.css line 382 both set the composer background. The CSS rule on .glass-composer is the source of truth now; the inline style{background:'transparent'} at line 1991 is redundant — could be removed to avoid drift if the CSS class is changed later.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 founder visual bugs (Iter 212m-54) + the Iter 212m-53 Ask Advisor admin slot pass clean against preview env. Reusable Playwright flow: login as founder → /admin → admin-nav-house_rules → scroll into view → exercise advisor-* testids. For chat tests: dismiss 'Skip for now' on the ORA guide modal first, then select mode-pill-maxx. Action-button colored outers are visible on hover of any assistant bubble (msg-actions-{idx}). The send button testid is 'chat-send' (NOT 'chat-send-btn' as the spec said).
rca of the issue: All bugs were CSS / inline-style scoping issues: (1) composer-card had a hardcoded dark rgba(13,16,24,0.32) wash that wiped out the Maxx amber tint inherited from ChatPanel — fixed by setting both the inline style and .glass-composer CSS rule to 'transparent'. (2) ActionBtn outer borders defaulted to gray var(--text-faint) and only colored on hover — fixed by passing an explicit color prop (yellow/green/red) used as the permanent border. (3) Topbar auto-hide only translated the row out of viewport but left its layout height intact, leaving a visible gap — fixed by adding height:0 + overflow:hidden when topHidden=true. (4) Same seam issue as (1).
